skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate on-screen editing instructions as text overlays synced to the vid...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Editing Text Generator — Generate Text Overlays for Videos".
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM video files up to 500MB; AI generates synced text overlays and editing instructions.
- Fast cloud-powered processing delivers text-overlaid 1080p MP4 videos in 30–90 seconds.
- No manual editing required — simply describe what you want; ideal for creators seeking rapid, dynamic titles or instructions.
- Includes guided workflow for session setup, status checks, credit balances, and error handling.
